english.note: Use this everyday noun for the effort or work put into getting something done.
Use this for effort invested in getting something done, rather than physical force.
Use 功夫 for the effort or labour put into accomplishing a particular task.

examples.english: We put a lot of graft into making this model.
examples.traditional: 整呢個模型真係落咗好多功夫。
